The '''Battle of Lorrad''' was fought between the [[Kingdom of Cron]] of [[Pirate King/Legends|Pirate King]] [[Xer VIII]] and the [[Back Spiral]] in the [[Pre-Republic era]], at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lorrad]].

Following the [[Battle of Chandaar|defeat]] of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ferece]], Xer installed himself as the new [[King of Cron]] and launched a series of campaigns to take control of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]. After have conquered the complete Kingdom of Cron and defeated the [[Three Allied Kingdoms]] and eventually the [[Back Spiral]], Xer's Empire reached its greatest extend. However, one power managed to stand against the Pirate King: the [[Livien League]]. Following a first battle at [[Amarin]], the Liviens defeated the Cronese fleet again at Lorrad. The twin defeats infuriated Xer but he took their lesson, concluding that he had overextended himself. He retreated from the League's borders and spent the remainder of his rule forging Cron into an empire.<ref name="Xim Week" />
